relations.evidence: 1944 he joined the National Central University Philosophy Department as a full-time professor, and later he even became head of the department. Only five years later, in 1949, Tang left mainland China

relations.subject: Tang Chun-I
relations.evidence: There he helped found the New Asia College, which was integrated into the Chinese University of Hong Kong in 1963.

relations.subject: Tang Chun-I

relations.evidence: He served as the founding chairman and the first Chair Professor of the Department of Philosophy of CUHK.
